# Carcis Autobody Repair

> Certified collision repair, paint, and custom body work in Vancouver, Washington. Insurance claims or personal pay, free estimates, newly opened in 2026.

## What we do

Carcis Autobody Repair handles dent repair, panel repair, rust repair, and collision repair, from minor fender-benders to major accident damage. We also do full and partial paint jobs matched to factory color, plus custom paint and design work and custom body work for builds that need something specific.

The shop is owned and run by Carlos Cisneros Carrasco, a certified auto body technician, and Kayla Cisneros Carrasco. Carlos trained specifically for auto body repair and has experience with custom paint designs, total-loss vehicle rebuilds, and rust repair on classic cars.

## Who we work with

Drivers in Vancouver, Washington and the surrounding area who need auto body repair, whether they are going through an insurance claim or paying out of pocket. Vehicles range from daily drivers with minor damage to classic and older cars needing rust or restoration work.

## How to engage

Book a free estimate directly on the website (Get an Estimate page), which opens a calendar to pick a time. You can also call or email directly.
